name: Monitor Routing Mock
description: Complete in-memory monitor/KVM routing provider (E19-06). Deterministic route + read-back, command_id idempotency, atomic apply_layout, and config-driven failure simulation (unreachable_outputs). Ports default to the bbz_core.domain.monitor catalog so it drives end-to-end tests unchanged. BBZ policy (the lower-left BBZ-OS rule) is enforced upstream in the domain, not here.
